ns2:course.label: Independent Study
ns2:course.description: Individual research on a special problem selected in consultation with the instructor. 0 to 2 professional hours. Approved for professional and graduate credit. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 2 hours.
